name: 13135 · Phoenix, NY
findings: ZIP 13135 (Phoenix) has 21 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 10 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (50% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 13135 (Phoenix) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
